title: Skydive Wissota

services.name: Skydive Wissota
services.desc: Skydive Wissota Welcomes Experienced Jumpers - you will always have people to jump with. We are a club focused on relative work and raising new skydivers, but all disciplines and experience levels are welcome to fly with us. You are welcome to camp at the dropzone or check out local hotels/lodging and restaurants by clicking here. Grill, microwave, and a pizza oven are available in the club, plus there is a huge fire pit on-site and you are welcome to stay after the jumping has stopped and hang out with us! Camping on-site with pull-out couches! © 2026 by ISPC Parachute Club / Skydive Wissota / Skydive Wisconsin / Skydive
